hero_subtitle: From booking to the last bite, here is what happens on a Simply Enak tour.

steps.title: Pick your tour and format
steps.detail: Browse our five tours across KL and Penang. Choose join-in (book a spot) or private (your group only).

steps.title: Book via WhatsApp or the tour page
steps.detail: Send us a WhatsApp or complete the booking form. We'll confirm your spot and answer any questions.

steps.title: We confirm and send you the prep guide
steps.detail: You'll get a confirmation with meeting point details and our preparation guide.

steps.title: Show up at the meeting point
steps.detail: Look for the Simply Enak guide with a blue badge. Arrive 5 minutes early if you can.

steps.title: Walk, eat, ask anything
steps.detail: Your guide takes you through 8 to 10+ tasting stops over 3.5 to 4 hours.

steps.title: Leave a review if you loved it
steps.detail: Reviews on TripAdvisor and Google help other travellers find us.
